listings.when: Every Wednesday, 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon and 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.

listings.offer: Community kitchen dinner, served to anyone in need, no questions asked.
listings.when: Monday to Friday, dinner. The provider page does not publish a serving time.

listings.offer: Free fresh fruit and vegetable distribution, first come, first served while supplies last, held with Feeding Westchester. Phone: 914-813-2896.
listings.when: Every first Wednesday of the month.

listings.when: Calls: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
listings.where: By phone. Serves Westchester, Putnam, Dutchess, Orange, Rockland, Sullivan and Ulster counties.
